title: 第525章 暗族之邀第524章 光族文明
lines: 离开光明星域，云澈并未立刻远遁，而是放慢了速度，一边在星空中徜徉，消化百年所得，体悟“光速时光”
身法与“光影相生”
之道，一边思忖着接下来的去处。
轮回境门槛清晰可见，但突破契机尚需寻觅。
或许，该回返人族疆域，或是前往一些传说中的险地历练？
正思索间，他忽然心有所感，停下遁光。
前方原本空无一物的虚空中，一团深邃的、仿佛能吸收一切光线的黑暗，悄无声息地弥漫开来，迅速扩张，形成一个不规则的阴影门户。
门户之中，并无阴森邪恶之感，只有一种纯粹的、包容一切的、幽深难测的“暗”
两道身影，从那阴影门户中缓缓“流淌”
而出。
他们仿佛与周围的黑暗融为一体，身形模糊，难以看清具体样貌，只能隐约看出是人形轮廓。
他们穿着与黑暗同色的贴身衣袍，气息幽深晦涩，仿佛能完美隐匿于任何阴影之中，若非云澈感知敏锐，加之对方似乎并无刻意完全隐藏，几乎难以察觉。
“暗族？”
云澈心中一动，神色平静，银眸之中，时光之痕微微流转，打量着来者。
他在万族盛宴上见过暗族代表，对方的气息与此二人如出一辙，只是眼前这两位，气息更加内敛，也更强，至少也是宙光境巅峰，其中领头那位，更是隐有轮回之意，应是暗族中的重要人物。
“云澈阁下，冒昧打扰，还请见谅。”
领头的那道暗影微微躬身，声音沙哑而低沉，仿佛从极幽深之处传来，但语气却颇为恭敬，并无敌意，“我族族长有感阁下离开光明星域，特命我等在此恭候，诚邀阁下前往暗影星域一叙。”
暗族族长相邀？云澈眸光微闪。
光族与暗族关系微妙，据说上古同源，后因理念分歧而分道扬镳，虽不至死敌，但也绝不和睦。
自己刚从光族做客百年，与光璃公主相交甚笃，暗族此刻邀请，是何用意？
“贵族长相邀，云澈倍感荣幸。
只是，”
云澈不动声色，试探道，“云某刚从光族离开，与光族稍有交情，贵族长此时相邀，莫非……”
“阁下多虑了。”
那暗影似乎看穿云澈心思，沙哑的声音中透着一丝奇异波动，仿佛是笑意，“我族与光族，理念虽有不同，道路各有选择，但并非生死仇敌。
无尽岁月以来，多有摩擦，却也并非全无交流。
族长大人此番相邀，乃是诚心与阁下论道，绝无他意。
且……族长大人言，有些关于‘光暗平衡’、‘宇宙大势’的见解，或对阁下之道途，有所裨益。”
“光暗平衡？宇宙大势？”
云澈心中一动。
他刚刚在光族参悟《光明真经》，对光暗辩证关系有所领悟，暗族便来相邀，还提及此话题，绝非巧合。
暗族族长，似乎对自己颇为关注。
而且，对方直言不讳，态度坦诚，反倒显得磊落。
“既如此，烦请二位带路。”
云澈略一沉吟，便做出了决定。
暗族神秘强大，若能前往一观，了解其文明与法则，对他完善自身之道，尤其是平衡新领悟的光明法则，或有奇效。
至于风险，对方若真有恶意，以暗族的手段，大可暗中行事，无需如此正式邀请。
且对方提及“光暗平衡”
，正中他下怀，值得一行。
content_en:
After leaving the light star field, Yun Che did not escape immediately, but slowed down, wandering in the starry sky, digesting the gains of a hundred years, and realizing the "speed of light"
Shen Dharma and "Light and Shadow"
way, while thinking about where to go next.
The threshold of the reincarnation realm is clearly visible, but the opportunity for breakthrough still needs to be found.
Perhaps, it’s time to return to the human territory, or go to some legendary dangerous places for experience?
While he was thinking about it, he suddenly felt something in his heart and stopped to escape.
In the originally empty void ahead, a deep darkness that seemed to be able to absorb all light spread quietly and expanded rapidly, forming an irregular shadow portal.
There is no sense of gloom and evil in the portal, only a pure, all-inclusive, and unfathomable "darkness"
Two figures slowly "flowed" from the shadow portal
And out.
They seemed to blend into the surrounding darkness, and their figures were blurry, making it difficult to see their specific appearance. Only the outline of a human figure could be vaguely seen.
They were wearing close-fitting robes of the same color as the darkness, and their auras were deep and obscure, as if they could perfectly hide in any shadow. If not for Yun Che's keen perception, and the fact that the other party did not seem to deliberately hide it completely, it would be almost difficult to detect.
"Dark Tribe?"
Yun Che's heart moved, his expression was calm, and the traces of time were flowing slightly in his silver eyes as he looked at the visitor.
He had seen representatives of the Dark Tribe at the feast of all races. The auras of the other party were exactly the same as those of the two people. However, the auras of the two in front of him were more restrained and stronger. They were at least at the peak of the Eternal Light Realm. The leader among them had a hint of reincarnation and should be an important figure in the Dark Tribe.
"Your Excellency Yun Che, please forgive me for disturbing you."
The leading shadow bowed slightly, and his voice was hoarse and low, as if coming from a very deep place, but his tone was quite respectful and not hostile, "The leader of our clan feels that you have left the Light Star Realm, and has specially ordered us to wait here. We sincerely invite you to go to the Shadow Star Realm to have a talk."
Invited by the leader of the Dark Tribe? Yun Che's eyes flashed slightly.
The relationship between the Light Tribe and the Dark Tribe is subtle. It is said that they had the same origin in ancient times, but later parted ways due to differences in ideas. Although they were not mortal enemies, they were by no means harmonious.
I have just been a guest from the Light Clan for a hundred years, and I have a close relationship with Princess Guangli. What is the purpose of the Dark Clan inviting her now?
“Yun Che feels extremely honored to be invited by a nobleman.
Just,"
Yun Che remained calm and probed, "Yun has just left the Guang Clan and has a little friendship with the Guang Clan. The noble leader invites you now. Could it be that..."
"Your Excellency, you are worrying too much."
The shadow seemed to see through Yun Che's thoughts, and there was a strange fluctuation in the hoarse voice, as if it was a smile, "Although our clan and the Light clan have different philosophies and have different paths to choose, they are not enemies of life and death.
Over the endless years, there have been many frictions, but not all communication.
The clan leader invites you this time because he sincerely discusses the truth with you and has no other intentions.
And... the patriarch said that some insights about the 'balance of light and darkness' and the 'general trend of the universe' may be of benefit to your path. "
"The balance of light and darkness? The general trend of the universe?"
Yun Che's heart moved.
He had just studied the "Light Sutra" in the Light Clan and understood the dialectical relationship between light and darkness, and the Dark Clan came to invite him and mentioned this topic. It was no coincidence.
The leader of the Dark Tribe seems to be quite concerned about him.
Moreover, the other party was outspoken and frank, which actually made him appear aboveboard.
"In that case, please lead the way."
Yun Che pondered for a moment before making a decision.
The Dark Tribe is mysterious and powerful. If one can go and have a look and understand its civilization and laws, it may be of great help to him in improving himself, especially in balancing the newly understood laws of light.
As for the risk, if the other party is really malicious, they can use the dark tribe's methods to act secretly without such a formal invitation.
And the other party mentioned "light and dark balance"
, just what he wanted, worthy of a trip.
title_en: Chapter 525 Invitation from the Dark Tribe Chapter 524 Light Tribe Civilization
